entities.name: Sami
entities.description: Captain of the Seriema, who escapes Taro-duend using the Guns of Kavaron, takes Alpharael and Haliya in under mallowmass, and searches for a missing cat named Mirri.

entities.name: Tannuk
entities.description: Sami's Kav first mate who pulls codes from the subedar's armor to turn the Guns of Kavaron on the Free Company.

entities.name: Alpharael
entities.description: A Monoist who paralyzes Haliya with an injector through the hole in his hand and joins the Seriema.

entities.name: Haliya
entities.description: A Sunstar squire who is shocked by Taro-duend's massacre, begs Vondam to kill her, and is left aboard the Seriema, doubting the Sum.

entities.name: Syr Vondam
entities.description: A Solar Knight who orders protocol seven and the massacre of Taro-duend but refuses to kill Haliya.

entities.name: Slats
entities.description: The Dawnsire's captain, who let Alpharael go.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Sami's lost cat, who weftwalked on Uthros several years ago and may still be in Sothera.

entities.name: The Metalman
entities.description: A metal-bodied being Sami calls a wizard, to whom Sami intends to give the stone in exchange for repairs.

entities.name: The Metalman's artifact
entities.description: The stone from Sigma held in the Seriema's stasis cask, whose luck and effects the Free Company and Sami debate.

entities.name: Seriema
entities.description: Sami's ship, which escapes Kavaron with a broken fusion drive using a puller sail pushed by the Guns of Kavaron.

entities.name: Sundog
entities.description: The Sunstar palestar that lasers Taro-duend, recovers its troops and leaves on a fusion blast.

entities.name: Hopelight warmaker
entities.description: A Sunstar fighter, callsign Flare Three, that pursues the Seriema and is destroyed by the Guns.

entities.name: Guns of Kavaron
entities.description: Kavaron's orbital-boost lasers, bounced off stratospheric mirrors, which Tannuk turns against the Free Company and then uses to push the Seriema out of the system.

entities.name: Taro-duend
entities.description: The Kav settlement on Kavaron That Is that the Sundog destroys with lasers and a fusion burn.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The ruined Kav world and the site of the atrocity.

entities.name: Mordraine Ring
entities.description: The debris ring above Kavaron that the Seriema crosses as it escapes.

entities.name: Dawnsire
entities.description: The Sunstar ship carrying a weapon that can reignite supervoids as stars.

entities.name: Candela
entities.description: The Sunstar ship Haliya's bind lives aboard, to which Vondam says the object will be returned.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Sunstar fighting order whose forces destroy Taro-duend following protocol seven.

entities.name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
entities.description: The Kav navy that swarms Kavaron That Is searching for those responsible for the atrocity.

entities.name: Monoism
entities.description: The faith of Alpharael, which Haliya fears the object might aid.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A station where Mirri went missing and where the Metalman is to be met.

entities.name: Anathalmanac
entities.description: The Sunstar book of protocols for handling anathema objects.

entities.name: Sum
entities.description: The Sunstar principle of maximizing life across time, whose demands Haliya now questions.

entities.name: Anstruth
entities.description: An outcome or person altered by the object to serve its purposes, which Haliya fears she is.

entities.name: Mallowmass
entities.description: A Kav-derived tradition of guest protection that Sami invokes to keep Haliya and Alpharael from fighting.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: A Monoist deity of black-hole inevitability.

events.summary: The Seriema's cargo ramp has been lowered by someone who found the ship, and Sami runs for it.
events.quote: Someone has found the Seriema , and the prow cargo ramp is down, opening the long jut of the number-one cargo bay to boarding.

events.summary: Sami finds Alpharael huddled at the feet of the frozen Sunstar armor, holding the stone and the injector.
events.quote: a suit of golden armor standing, frozen, over Alpharael, who is huddled wretchedly around its ankles

events.summary: Alpharael says the armored woman killed Sami, though she didn't.
events.quote: "She killed you," Alpharael says.

events.summary: Vondam announces to all units that they are going to protocol seven and have two minutes.
events.quote: We are going to protocol seven. You have two minutes.

events.summary: Sami resolves to try escaping despite near-zero odds.
events.quote: Our chances of flying out of here with a palestar and Hopelights overhead are zero.

events.summary: Tannuk reveals he has pulled the subedar armor's Guns codes.
events.quote: And the encryption's no match for Pinnacle breakers. I pulled them already.

events.summary: Sami lifts the Seriema out of the cave and over the slag field.
events.quote: Sami gooses the ship up on a pulse of thrust.

events.summary: A Hopelight lasers off the Seriema's main drive nozzle.
events.quote: The main drive! They took out the mag nozzle!

events.summary: Haliya appears in the cockpit and offers herself as a hostage.
events.quote: "Looking for a hostage?" Haliya says.

events.summary: In a flashback, Haliya's armor frees her from the paralytic, and she shocks Alpharael's hands and makes him put the stone in stasis.
events.quote: She fries his left hand, too, so he drops the object.

events.summary: Haliya demands the ship land and puts herself on the distress frequency so Vondam will hear.
events.quote: Land this ship. Put me on one-forty-two.

events.summary: The Sundog lasers every heat source in Taro-duend as it recovers its soldiers.
events.quote: The Sundog is killing everything in Taro-duend with its lasers.

events.summary: The Sundog sets houses on fire after the fleeing Kav gather inside.
events.quote: The Sundog lets them gather, then sets the houses on fire.

events.summary: Haliya radios Vondam, claiming she has the object and urging him to stop killing the Kav.
events.quote: Syr Vondam. Syr Vondam, this is Squire Haliya.

events.summary: Vondam tells Haliya to kill the crew and force the ship down.
events.quote: We'll keep pace until you can kill the crew and force it down.

events.summary: Haliya urges Vondam to order her death as protocol seven requires.
events.quote: We traded places. Now you must order mine!

events.summary: Vondam refuses to destroy the ship, wanting the object retrieved in stasis.
events.quote: We'll retrieve the object and return it to Candela in stasis.

events.summary: The Sundog ignites its main fusion engine over Taro-duend, killing survivors with radiation and fire.
events.quote: The palestar has ignited its main fusion engine.

events.summary: Sami refuses Alpharael's offer to use the stone to undo the atrocity.
events.quote: It didn't work on Sigma, and it won't work here.

events.summary: Haliya begs Vondam to kill her too if the object is worth so much.
events.quote: Syr, kill me. If this object is worth so much.

events.summary: Sami takes Vondam's silence as permission to escape.
events.quote: May I take this as your permission to make my escape?

events.summary: Tannuk finds a stratosat balloon and uses the subedar's codes to request the Guns' radar.
events.quote: Forty kilometers above the southern horizon is an armored stratosat balloon.

events.summary: The Sundog lasers the stratosat after realizing what Tannuk is doing.
events.quote: A laser flicks out and kills the stratosat.

events.summary: The Guns of Kavaron fire on the pursuing Hopelight.
events.quote: The Guns of Kavaron fire.

events.summary: The Hopelight Flare Three is hit by the Guns, loses its tail and ejects its crew.
events.quote: The Hopelight, callsign Flare Three , flashes up white.

events.summary: The Sundog jams the radar, so the Guns miss their second shot.
events.quote: The Guns stab down again. But this time, they miss.

events.summary: The Seriema lunges up into space.
events.quote: The Seriema lunges up into space.

events.summary: The Guns' boost beams push the Seriema's mirrored sail out across the Mordraine Ring into interplanetary space.
events.quote: And when their beams converge on the Seriema 's sail, carefully diffused to avoid melting right through it, they push the little ship.

events.summary: The Kavaron Memorial Navy swarms Kavaron That Is searching for the authors of the atrocity.
events.quote: But by now, every ship in the Kavaron Memorial Navy is swarming out over Kavaron That Is, looking for the authors of the atrocity captured on the Seriema 's cameras.

events.summary: Sami declares Alpharael and Haliya guests under mallowmass to stop them fighting.
events.quote: Captain Sami declares that all their new passengers are guests under the protection of mallowmass.

events.summary: Haliya reflects that she can never be a Sunstar knight after the atrocity and her desertion.
events.quote: She will never be a Sunstar knight of the Free Company.

events.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
events.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

events.summary: Haliya and Alpharael explain to Sami how they came to Kavaron.
events.quote: Together the two of them explain to Captain Sami how they came to Kavaron.

events.summary: Haliya argues that the Sunstar, not Alpharael, bear responsibility for the dead Kav.
events.quote: He's not responsible for the dead Kav at Taro-duend, either. We are.

events.summary: Haliya concludes that Vondam obeyed the Sum but that the massacre was nonetheless wrong.
events.quote: But it was wrong. I know it.

events.summary: Haliya decides the object must be destroyed, and Sami objects.
events.quote: We need to destroy the object. It poisons everything.

events.summary: Sami reveals they are looking for their lost cat Mirri.
events.quote: I look for my cat.

events.summary: Sami explains that Mirri weftwalked on Uthros and vanished.
events.quote: She weftwalked.

events.summary: Haliya offers to help look for the cat.
events.quote: I'll help you look for the cat,

events.summary: Sami insists the stone will be given to the Metalman rather than destroyed.
events.quote: We're giving it to the Metalman.

events.summary: Sami tells them the Metalman is a wizard.
events.quote: I told you. He's a wizard .

relations.note: Tannuk flies the escape beside Sami.
relations.quote: Sami just needs two quick hands, Tannuk at their side, and a hundred kilometers of altitude.

relations.note: Sami is searching for their missing cat.
Sami plans to give the stone to the Metalman in return for repairs.
relations.quote: We're giving it to the Metalman.

relations.note: The Sundog is a Free Company palestar that carries out protocol seven.
relations.quote: the Sundog is recovering its soldiers.
